`interface IGlBinding`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`JournalGlBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/journalglbinding/), [`Lwjgl2GlBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl2/lwjgl2glbinding/), [`Lwjgl3GlBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-opengl/lwjgl3glbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.binding` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [IGlBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/binding/IGlBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The OpenGL calls of the OpenGL module, one method per OpenGL function, implemented once per library.

## Description

[`GlRenderBridge`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/) calls OpenGL only through a binding, so base-opengl compiles against no LWJGL version: pass [`Lwjgl3GlBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-opengl/lwjgl3glbinding/), [`Lwjgl2GlBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl2/lwjgl2glbinding/) or the OpenGL functions of your engine.
The arguments are the values of [`GlConstants`](/reference/base-opengl/glconstants/); a binding passes them to OpenGL unchanged and adds no check.
Every method runs on the render thread, with the context of JOID current.

## Method details

<a id="IGlBinding-method-canPointClientMemory"></a>

### canPointClientMemory

`boolean canPointClientMemory()` <span class="joid-qualifier">default</span>

If `true`, the binding can hand OpenGL a pointer into client memory; `true` by default.
Return `false` when it cannot: the state guard then leaves the client vertex arrays of a compatibility host as they are.

<a id="IGlBinding-method-getFrameBufferBinding"></a>

### getFrameBufferBinding

---

<small>`fluent` returns the instance, typed for chaining · `factory` creates an instance · `signal` also accepts a value that follows signals, as a signal, an expression or a lambda ([When does JOID compute this value again?](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/#ask-when-does-joid-compute-this-value-again)) · `hook` called by JOID, override it · `abstract` you implement it · `default` interface method with a body · `static` called on the class · `protected` visible to subclasses</small>
